inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev1 non-identity rigid inverse-bind rebaking and inherited 2.9 template-free GMX, animation, TEX, schema, graph, mod-workspace and source-only gates are inherited. Dev2 adds disjoint rigid joint-island partitioning and an explicit-transform multi-GMX glTF assembly layer without inventing native blended skinning or unrecovered boss placements.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 84/84 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: True blended/multi-joint deformation is not encoded; triangles spanning rigid joint partitions are rejected because no confirmed native per-vertex skin representation exists.

PROGRESSIVE UFO component membership/count is evidence-backed, but the four side-component runtime transforms have not yet been recovered and are deliberately left unresolved in the built-in manifest.
Assembly export produces a combined glTF viewing/editing scene; it does not claim the retail game stores or accepts one merged native GMX for multipart runtime entities.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 donor-free TEX wrapper synthesis remains structurally validated rather than hardware/emulator-proven.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX no-op evidence and dev7 retail skin-field evidence are inherited rather than rerun/bundled from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
